content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Define the Gateway User ID ## slug: define-the-gateway-user-id ## seoTitle: Define the Gateway User ID ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End Now that you are connected to your {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}, you need to manually copy the “API Login ID” from your Authorize.net account and paste it in the {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} {{variable.Field_PG_GatewayUserID}} field. 1. Log into your Authorize.net account. 2. Click **Account** and then **API Credentials and Keys**. ![H_02_01_define gateway user id 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_01_define%20gateway%20user%20id%201.png){height="" width=""} 3. Copy the “API Login ID”. ![H_02_01_define gateway user id 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_01_define%20gateway%20user%20id%202.png){height="" width=""} 4. Enter the “API Login ID” in the {{variable.Field_PG_GatewayUserID}} field. ![H_02_01_define gateway user id 3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_02_01_define%20gateway%20user%20id%203.png){height="" width=""} 5. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}.
